card.name: Start of swallow and swish instructions
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word swallow or swish (Sw, sw, SW) in dosing instructions, and also 'without' before swallowing after rinsing. It appears where the next words concern the mouth.

modes.label: Swallow
modes.description: The opening piece of 'swallow' in directions on swallowing tablets or mixtures whole.
modes.example: 2.3 Method of Administration For Patients Unable to<< Sw>>allow Viracept Tablets • Place VIR

modes.label: Swish
modes.description: The opening piece of 'swish' in directions to rinse the mouth after a dissolving product.
modes.example: take a sip of water,<< sw>>ish gently around the teeth and gums,

modes.label: Rinse and spit
modes.description: The word 'without' in directions to rinse the mouth and spit without swallowing.
modes.example: advise patients to rinse their mouth with water and spit out the contents<< without>> swallowing.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward mouth words and away from taste words.
